functors.F6-BREAK-B: NEGATIVE CONTROL WITH TEETH: carrier map = the identity with two points of different orbits transposed, group map = the identity.

held_out.construction_rule: the morphism is fitted on the FIT orbit and extended to every other orbit by the declared SOURCE symmetry (front translations and a register translation transverse to rho) carried by a declared assignment into the target group. held_out.split_rule: the source orbits are ordered lexicographically by their minimal element; FIT = orbit 0 only; HELD = every other orbit.  Sizes computed.

predicate.NT1: phi is non-trivial (the group action is carried, not killed)
predicate.NT2: Phi is non-constant (the carrier is not collapsed to a point)
predicate.SP1: phi is a homomorphism: phi(g h) = phi(g) phi(h) at every one of the |G_src|^2 ordered pairs (composition preserved)
predicate.SP3: Phi is phi-equivariant: Phi(g . x) = phi(g) . Phi(x) at every one of the |G_src| x |C_src| cells (the group actions preserved)
predicate.arena_invariance: SP references only the group actions, the composition and carrier incidence; never a prime value, never a label name, never a carrier index.  Measured by the relabelling, conjugation and generator-change self-tests (RUNBOOK 14).

registered_opens.OPEN-1: Can the reduction prime be fixed by anything other than declaration?  Every live cell is prime-dependent by construction, so requirement 4 excludes it however good the transport side gets.  The successor's dichotomy: DERIVE THE PRIME, or accept declaration-relative bridging and say so.
registered_opens.OPEN-2: Why do the prepared bases concentrate in the closed sector?  The declared completion family is majority-live; every committed instance sits in the low-defect-order band.  Is that a selection rule of the preparation or an artifact of which bases happen to have been built?

strengthened_standard.S1-ENCODING-INTERTWINING: THE NON-NEGOTIABLE.  The functor must make a COMMUTING SQUARE at the encoding layer, not a triangle at the group layer: HA's record-is-metric linear map (determinant 2) intertwined with GEN/XBA's Q -> delta(Q) = Sigma Q^T Sigma Q.  While the encoding factorises through the group actions, nothing physical is carried.
strengthened_standard.S2-CARRIER-RIGIDITY: SP3 supplemented so that Phi is DETERMINED, not chosen -- e.g. the fixed-configuration stratification (transport: 9/18/27/36/45/54/81) carried into the source stratification.
strengthened_standard.S3-NON-DEGENERACY-WITH-TEETH: NT2 replaced by injectivity on orbits, or at least a measured lower bound on |image(Phi)| as a fraction of the orbit count.
strengthened_standard.S4-FUNCTORIALITY-IN-THE-FAMILY: naturality across the declared base-change maps, so that a live cell is not an isolated coincidence at one (p, ord(D)).
strengthened_standard.S5-HELD-OUT-AT-A-LIVE-CELL-WITH-A-TRANSP: a computed physical quantity transported out of sample at a live cell, not equivariance alone.
strengthened_standard.S6-AN-IN-ARENA-READING-OF-REQUIREMENT-4: either the prime declared a parameter of the arena with per-prime verdicts, or a corpus-internal fixing of p.
strengthened_standard.status: REGISTERED, NOT TESTED.  No cell of any scope in this unit is evaluated against S1-S6, in either direction.

transport_side.carrier: C_TR = the system pair (m^2 labels) x the pointer pair (m^2 labels), index i = m^2 * a + p
transport_side.defect: D = (Sigma Q^T Sigma Q) (x) I, Q the declared completion permutation of the system-pair labels (GEN 8.1)
transport_side.exchange: Sigma: the label exchange (u,v) -> (v,u); W = Sigma (x) Sigma
transport_side.extended_scope_3: the whole declared completion family, 8! members
transport_side.group: <W, D> = the dihedral group of order 2*ord(D) (XBA 8.1-8.3), the form FORCED by PSI's one law: with W^2 = 1 and D = [W,u], W D W = (W W u^-1 W u W) = u^-1 W u W = D^-1, so <W,D> is dihedral of order 2*ord(D) whenever W is not a power of D
transport_side.one_law: PSI (terminal): D(psi) = [P_W, u(psi)] = P_W u^-1 P_W u with P_W an involution.  Everything the obstruction says about <W,D> is a consequence of that law and holds for every base the law covers, prepared or not.

disclosures.statement: The count |hom(Z/p, D_n)| = gcd(n, p) is analytically forced FOR ODD p; it FAILS at p = 2, which is inadmissible on the deformation side, and the failures are measured here rather than asserted.  It is recorded as a disclosure and is NOT used as a gate; both census routes compute the count without invoking it.

At GEN's equivariant class the group |<W,D>| = 2 while GEN's measured based-holonomy group order is 1, because that base refuses the links altogether.  These are two different coordinates; this unit's census consumes the <W,D> coordinate (XBA's), and the agreement gate is taken at the eleven classes of defect order >= 2 where the two coordinates coincide.

Base 1's defect and base S's defect are not determined by the published receipts.  Neither is guessed: the whole set of candidates consistent with every committed datum is swept, and every member gives the same group order, so the ambiguity cannot move a census count.

The synthetic FOUND branch is exhibited at a DECLARED SYNTHETIC pair, at the prime 3, which is outside the deformation side's admissible primes: rho = (1/6,1/6) does not reduce there.  It is NOT the only exercise of the FOUND machinery: the same held-out protocol is run at the live extended-scope cells, at the DECLARED-ADMISSIBLE primes 5 and 7, and passes there too (G36).  What excludes those cells is requirement 4, not a failure of the verification.

Over the EXTENDED scopes a non-trivial group morphism does exist -- at p = 5 into the defect-order-5 and defect-order-15 classes and at p = 7 into the defect-order-7 class -- and each of them extends, because the source action is free, to non-degenerate pairs in counts of 240, 240 and 656 digits (G36).  They satisfy the full delivered predicate, not merely its group clause.  They are measured and reported, and excluded from the verdict by pin requirement 4 because their existence is a function of the declared reduction prime.

The functor-level census counts the SP-satisfying pairs by the orbit-representative formula; the counts are astronomically large and entirely degenerate.  Only the non-degenerate count enters any argument.

The held-out check is a TWO-VALUED measurement, not a test of the declared extension formula: for any rotation-valued extension the held-out equations hold identically because <D> is abelian, and every reflection-valued one fails at the same cells.  Measured under five declared rotation rules and their five reflection counterparts (G39).  What the check verifies is centraliser membership.

THE TWO OUTCOMES ARE HELD TO DIFFERENT EVIDENTIAL STANDARDS.  EMPTY is measured against the intersection reading at every instance of both scopes; FOUND is exhibited at a synthetic pair and at the live cells that requirement 4 excludes.  Under this unit's declared reading of requirement 4 an in-arena FOUND was foreclosed before any census ran, by an arithmetic the unit computes: two declared primes need 2*ord(D) divisible by their product, and the declared family's maximum is below it (G41).

detail.forward_routes: one criterion, two implementations, shared model

disclosures.statement: The two FORWARD census routes are two implementations of one criterion -- g^p = e and ord(g) | p are the same predicate -- over a SHARED abstract model, and are disclosed as such rather than advertised as independent computations.  What audits the shared model is a different gate: the explicit isomorphism from the model to the permutation rebuild, verified on every ordered pair (G03), together with the abelianisation measurement (G27).  The two REVERSE routes are genuinely different computations (word evaluation in G, versus construction of the abelianisation and its own quotient table).

G27's outcome is analytically forced for the dihedral family -- the abelianisation of a dihedral group is Z/2 or Z/2 x Z/2 -- and the dihedral form is itself forced by the one law (G35).  It is retained as a gate because the commutator subgroup is BUILT rather than cited, so a wrong model is caught there; the forcing is recorded here.  G14's outcome is forced in the nine-label arena only, and G40 measures that it is contingent at sixteen labels.

THE STRENGTHENED STANDARD IS REGISTERED AND UNTESTED.  The six requirements a live-cell morphism would have to meet before the word 'bridge' is earned -- encoding intertwining as a commuting square first among them -- are declared at DECL.strengthened_standard as the successor's gate.  NO cell of any scope in this unit is evaluated against them, in either direction: this unit's EMPTY and its live cells are both at the DELIVERED standard.

Three of this unit's anchors carry values published in the XBA paper's committed table rather than in a receipt's JSON: species 4's defect and exchange fixed-configuration counts and its 120-member transposition split.  The paper file is hash-pinned here so those anchors are hash-protected, and all three are recomputed from the rebuilt permutations.

gates.claim: THE DECLARATIONS ARE FROZEN BEFORE ANY CANDIDATE MORPHISM IS EVALUATED: the carrier functors, the structure-preservation predicate, the held-out set and the arena are declared as data, and the candidate-evaluation counter is measured ZERO at the freeze point

CELL-COMPLETENESS OF THE COMPLETION-FAMILY SWEEP: every member of the declared family is classified exactly once and the swept count equals the declared family size, computed by enumeration and not typed

THE ABSTRACT DIHEDRAL MODEL IS AUDITED BY AN INDEPENDENTLY CONSTRUCTED COMPARATOR (RUNBOOK 14 addendum, v13 #219): the comparator is the permutation rebuild from the completion Q and Sigma, never the abstract model it audits; the two agree in ORDER at every rebuilt instance, and the model is certified ISOMORPHIC to the rebuild by the explicit map (i,k) -> D^i W^k, measured bijective and multiplicative on every ordered pair -- order agreement alone would not imply isomorphism, and both census routes consume this model

THE UNDER-DETERMINED COMMITTED INSTANCES ARE SWEPT, NOT GUESSED: base 1's defect and base S's defect are each replaced by the whole declared set of candidates consistent with every committed datum -- the constraints being READ from the pinned XBA receipt and anchored, and the class size COMPUTED from the family classification rather than typed -- and every member of each set gives the same group order, so the ambiguity cannot move any census count

POSITIVE CONTROL: the identity self-morphism inside each arena is FOUND by the very census machinery used for the bridge -- every predicate clause holds and both non-triviality clauses hold, on the deformation side, on the abelian transport instance and on the NON-ABELIAN transport instance alike, so the action's orientation convention is exercised where it can bite

THE DEGENERATE FUNCTOR IS A NAMED KILL: the constant carrier map with the trivial group map SATISFIES the structure-preservation predicate and is REJECTED by the non-triviality clauses (DEGENERATE-COLLAPSE) -- so the census cannot be won by collapsing either side to a point

NEGATIVE CONTROL WITH TEETH: the register-doubling carrier map with the IDENTITY group map is REJECTED by the equivariance clause, while the SAME carrier map with the group map R -> R^2 is ACCEPTED -- so the predicate is sensitive to exactly the structure it claims to test and not to gross malformation; a second breaking map (two points of different orbits transposed) is rejected too
THE COMPOSITION CLAUSE HAS TEETH: a declared NON-homomorphism that fixes the identity is REJECTED by SP1, measured over all |G|^2 ordered pairs

CELL-COMPLETENESS OF THE COMMITTED-SCOPE CENSUS: every (prime, instance) cell of the declared scope is visited exactly once, the cell count is COMPUTED from the declared sets and equals the number of rows returned, and both directions are counted at every cell

TWO INDEPENDENT ROUTES AGREE AT EVERY CELL: the element-power route (iterated multiplication in the target) and the subgroup-lattice route (every subset closed, the cyclic subgroups of order dividing p counted with their generators) return the same homomorphism count at every cell, in both directions, and neither route reads the other
CELL-COMPLETENESS OF THE EXTENDED-SCOPE CENSUS: every (prime, rebuilt class) cell is visited exactly once and the count is computed from the declared sets

THE COMMITTED-SCOPE VERDICT IS INVARIANT ACROSS THE WHOLE DECLARED PRIME SWEEP: the census answer is the same at every one of the declared primes, so no quantity that moves with the declared reduction prime carries it (the sweep must contain more than one prime for the gate to be posable)

THE PRIME-TRACKING GATE BITES, MEASURED: the declared morphism-by-spectrum candidate F3 SURVIVES at some declared primes and DIES at others, so the arena-invariance rule that rejects it is not vacuous; and the candidate's verdict is measured to coincide, prime by prime, with the extended-scope census's own answer -- the spectrum criterion IS the extended-scope census, and both are prime-tracking

THE PRIME-TRACKING CANDIDATE IS EXCLUDED FROM THE VERDICT (pin requirement 4): a candidate whose survival is a function of the declared reduction prime is an arena artifact; it is recorded as an instrument reading and the verdict is taken over the arena-invariant content only -- the intersection over the declared prime sweep, which is measured EMPTY at every instance of every declared scope, and no instance admits even two declared primes.  THE REASON IS SCOPED TO THE NINE-LABEL ARENA: admitting two declared primes needs 2*ord(D) divisible by their product, and the whole nine-label family's maximum is smaller than that product -- both numbers computed here.  At the sixteen-label arena the same clause is CONTINGENT, not forced, and a witness is exhibited

detail.the_arena_invariant_census: EMPTY at every instance of every declared scope

gates.claim: RUNBOOK 14 SYMMETRY SELF-TESTS, ON A CANDIDATE THE ACTION COULD MOVE: the predicate's verdict is measured INVARIANT under the arena's own action -- relabelling either carrier, conjugating the transport action by a carrier permutation, and replacing the source generator R by R^j for every j -- carried on an ACCEPTED NON-DEGENERATE candidate (the register doubling with the group map R -> R^2, and the target's identity self-morphism) as well as on the degenerate one; and the generator sweep CONSUMES the arena it builds, recomputing that arena's orbit count and freeness and re-evaluating the accepted candidate inside it.  The tested set is fixed by declaration and never selected by the verdicts under audit

the_carried_candidates.accepted_non_degenerate: the register doubling with the group map R -> R^2 on the source side; the target's translation self-morphism (carrier map = the action of W, group map = the identity automorphism)
the_carried_candidates.degenerate: the constant carrier map with the trivial group map

gates.claim: THE SELF-TESTS EVALUATE FRESH, AND THE CACHE PATH IS EXERCISED (RUNBOOK 14 addenda, v13 #185 and #219): every self-test evaluation bypasses the memo cache, the self-test's cache-hit count is measured ZERO against a nonzero bypass count, and the cache is measured to be looked up and hit elsewhere in the run -- a zero-hit gate over zero lookups would be vacuous

THE ORBIT COUNT IS COMPUTED TWICE BY DIFFERENT MEANS AND THE FUNCTOR-LEVEL CENSUS IS CELL-COMPLETE: union-find over the generator's own edges and the division of the carrier size by the orbit length (the action is measured free) agree at every cell; and the cell count is COMPUTED from the declared sets -- the declared primes times the instances rebuilt as permutation groups -- with every cell visited exactly once, so a dropped cell cannot pass (RUNBOOK 13 addendum, v13 #234)

THE EQUIVARIANT-MAP COUNT IS COMPUTED BY TWO INDEPENDENT ROUTES: the orbit-representative formula, and an EXHAUSTIVE brute-force enumeration of every function from the source carrier to the target carrier filtered by the very predicate the census uses, at declared tiny cells that include a cell with non-trivial group maps and a cell with none, that are cell-complete against the declaration, whose source generators are measured to satisfy gen^p = identity (so the declared group really acts), and whose ORBIT EXPONENTS include a value above 1 -- the exponent is what the formula asserts

THE COUNT FORMULA'S HYPOTHESIS IS MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: at a declared negative-control cell whose source generator's order does NOT divide the declared prime -- so the declared group does not act -- the orbit-representative formula and the exhaustive brute force DISAGREE, and the disagreement is measured here; every cell of the validation set is measured to satisfy the hypothesis the formula needs, and the committed census's own source action is measured free at every cell

detail.the_formula_needs: a genuine free Z/p action on the source

gates.claim: THE DICTIONARY CENSUS IS SWEPT AT A DECLARED FINITE SCOPE WITH ITS SIZE COMPUTED: the space of record->completion dictionaries is |family|^|records|, computed by exponentiation from the two measured set sizes, and the admissible count is a PRODUCT over the records of per-record counts, each obtained by sweeping the whole defect order spectrum -- never one expression

AT THE COMMITTED SCOPE THE DICTIONARY CENSUS IS EMPTY BY A COMPUTED PRODUCT: when the dictionary's image is restricted to the committed completions, the per-record admissible count is ZERO at every declared prime, so the product over the nine records is zero and no dictionary survives

BRG-MORPHISM-FOUND IS REACHABLE, AND ITS HELD-OUT VERIFICATION IS PREDICTIVE: at the declared synthetic compatible pair the census returns non-trivial group maps and the constructed carrier morphism is ACCEPTED; the morphism is fitted on the declared FIT orbit alone and extended by the declared source symmetry, and its equivariance is then verified on every HELD orbit -- equations the construction never imposed

THE HELD-OUT VERIFICATION HAS TEETH: the SAME construction with the declared reflection-valued extension FAILS the held-out check at a measured, nonzero number of cells, while the rotation-valued extension passes at every one -- so the held-out gate can fail, and passing it is a measurement

THE HELD-OUT SET IS PURE: the construction touched only the declared FIT orbit, the HELD orbits were declared before any morphism was constructed, and the two sets partition the source orbits with computed sizes

THE DECLARED HELD-OUT QUANTITIES TRANSPORT: the orbit-size multiset, the generators' fixed-point counts, the element-order multisets and the whole source composition table are computed on both sides and the morphism carries each of them correctly

BRG-EMPTY-AT-CARRIER IS REACHABLE BY THE SAME MACHINERY: at the declared synthetic incompatible pair the census returns NO non-trivial group map, so the census's other value is attainable and neither outcome is a predicate that cannot fail

THE FORWARD OBSTRUCTION IS NAMED, AND IT IS MEASURED COEXTENSIVE WITH THE FORWARD CENSUS'S EMPTINESS IN BOTH DIRECTIONS OF THE EQUIVALENCE: over every cell of every declared scope, the forward census is empty EXACTLY where gcd(p, |<W,D>|) = 1 -- so the named forward obstruction is order-coprimality (a prime source group and a transport group whose order 2*ord(D) is not divisible by it), and the naming is falsifiable because cells of both kinds occur.  This is a statement about the FORWARD census only; the reverse census has its own, different obstruction (G34)

THE REVERSE DIRECTION IS EMPTY EVERYWHERE, AND ITS OBSTRUCTION IS A SECOND, PRIME-INDEPENDENT ONE: every homomorphism from a transport group to Z/p kills the commutator subgroup, and the abelianisation is measured to be a 2-group at every instance of every scope, so for every ODD declared prime the reverse census is trivial -- with no dependence on the prime at all

THE SECOND OBSTRUCTION, NAMED BESIDE THE FIRST: THE REVERSE CENSUS IS EMPTY AT EVERY ONE OF THE DECLARED CELLS -- INCLUDING THE LIVE ONES.  Where the forward census is non-trivial the reverse census is still zero, so the reverse emptiness is NOT coextensive with order-coprimality: the mismatch is measured and nonzero, and the reverse obstruction is the 2-group abelianisation, which does not mention the prime.  MEASURED CONSEQUENCE: at every declared cell the structure-preserving maps run in ONE direction only, deformation -> transport, so 'built FROM' could at most mean embedding as a sub-object, and that only where a forward morphism exists at all

THE TWO SETS ARE BOTH COMPUTED, AND THEIR EQUALITY IS GATED (RUNBOOK 4: counts computed, never typed): the primes dividing 2*ord(D) at the committed instances are obtained by trial division over the measured defect orders, the primes at which the deformation side's exact residual fails to reduce are obtained by testing the denominator, and the two sets are compared here.  THE COINCIDENCE HAS ONE DEGREE OF FREEDOM, MEASURED: the prime 2 divides 2*ord(D) at every instance by the dihedral form, and the prime 3 enters from ONE instance alone -- delete it and the union is {2}, while the inclusion in {2,3} survives

THE OBSTRUCTION THEOREM IS LAGRANGE + CAUCHY, WITH NO DIHEDRAL HYPOTHESIS: for a finite group G and a prime q, hom(Z/q, G) is trivial IFF q does not divide |G| -- Lagrange forward (an element of order q would generate a subgroup of order q), Cauchy back (q | |G| yields an element of order q).  Swept over a declared group zoo that is NOT only dihedral -- cyclic, dihedral, symmetric, alternating and direct products, abelian and non-abelian -- with zero failures.  THE GEOMETRIC CONTENT IS THEREFORE THE ORDER FORMULA |<W,D>| = 2*ord(D), NOT THE HOM COUNT: the same criterion read through 2*ord(D) instead of |G| is measured to FAIL off the dihedral family

THE OBSTRUCTION IS A THEOREM ABOUT THE ONE-LAW FAMILY, NOT ABOUT EIGHT MEASURED COINCIDENCES.  Given only the one law's two ingredients -- W^2 = 1 and D = [W,u] -- the relation W D W = D^-1 is forced by algebra: W(W u^-1 W u)W = u^-1 W u W = (W u^-1 W u)^-1.  Hence <W,D> is dihedral of order 2*ord(D) whenever W is not a power of D, and the forward obstruction holds for EVERY base the law covers, including bases the corpus has not built.  Measured over a randomised family sweep whose seed is the sha256 of declared data alone, with a control in which W is NOT an involution and the relation must fail
